'''Sapra''' was an old [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]]. He was one of a number of the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] crews contracted by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to supply their [[Sarahwiee Imperial base|base]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sarahwiee]]. Sapra played [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] with [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Tere Metallo]].
